purpose: Teach: 市政/不正確/手引き/ライフサイクル/移設/定率/不払い/ファクス

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、地域の市政との関わりも学べ
lines.en: Ren, you need to learn how local government operations work too.
lines.style: Measured directive from someone used to being heard. Clear but not harsh. Assumes he'll listen and act on it. Slight pause after the name—establishing attention before the instruction lands.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。データの不正確さを徹底排除します
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure all the data is completely accurate.
lines.style: Quick, respectful intake of instruction. Slight lean forward in posture. Affirming tone without overdoing it. Already thinking ahead to how he'll execute it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究装置の手引きを整理しろ
lines.en: Ren, organize the manuals and documentation for the research equipment.
lines.style: Firm, direct assignment. The tone of someone delegating work they expect will be done right. No inflection that softens it—just clarity. Brief.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究テーマのライフサイクルを意識します
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep the research timeline and lifecycle in mind as I do it.
lines.style: Respectful confirmation with a note of understanding—he's not just taking the task, he's grasped the context. Quiet, attentive tone. Ends with quiet resolve.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室移設の手伝いをしろ
lines.en: Ren, help with moving the lab to its new location.
lines.style: Straightforward instruction delivered as a fact, not a question. Hiroshi's voice is assured but not unkind. The efficiency of someone who says what needs saying and moves on.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験消耗品の定率購入を計画します
lines.en: Understood. I'll draw up a schedule for ordering lab consumables at regular intervals.
lines.style: Immediate, polite acceptance. He's already mentally organizing the logistics. Steady, practical tone—competence without flourish. Shows he understands the scope.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究費の不払いトラブルを避けろ
lines.en: Ren, watch out for any payment disputes with the research fund. Don't let them happen.
lines.style: A warning that carries weight. Hiroshi's tone shifts slightly here—more protective than directive. Still measured, but there's careful concern underneath. Wants him alert.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。海外文献の取り寄せはファクスでも対応します
lines.en: Yes. I can arrange foreign journal deliveries by fax if needed—whatever it takes.
lines.style: Quick, final confirmation. Ren is already problem-solving aloud, showing he understood the underlying concern. Quiet determination. Ends on a note of readiness and closure.
